question: Find the name of the tallest superhero who has the 'Agility' power, is not aligned as 'Neutral', and has a 'Speed' attribute value greater than the average 'Speed' across all superheroes.

arguments.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1."XCL_027" = T2."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T3 ON T1."XCL_018" = T3."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T4 ON T3."XCL_010" = T4."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_002" != 'Neutral'
  AND T4."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
  AND T3."XCL_011" > (
      SELECT AVG(T5."XCL_011")
      FROM hero_attribute AS T5
      INNER JOIN attribute AS T6 ON T5."XCL_010" = T6."XCL_003"
      WHERE T6."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS T7
      INNER JOIN superpower AS T8 ON T7."XCL_013" = T8."XCL_030"
      WHERE T7."XCL_012" = T1."XCL_018" AND T8."XCL_031" = 'Agility'
  )
ORDER BY T1."XCL_028" DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1."XCL_027" = T2."XCL_001"

INNER JOIN attribute AS T4 ON T3."XCL_010" = T4."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_002" != 'Neutral'
  AND T4."XCL_004" = 'Speed'

  )
ORDER BY T1."XCL_028" DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1."XCL_019" FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1."XCL_027" = T2."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T3 ON T1."XCL_018" = T3."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T4 ON T3."XCL_010" = T4."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_002" != 'Neutral'
AND T4."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
AND T3."XCL_011" > (SELECT AVG(T5."XCL_011") FROM hero_attribute AS T5 INNER JOIN attribute AS T6 ON T5."XCL_010" = T6."XCL_003" WHERE T6."XCL_004" = 'Speed')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hero_power AS T7 INNER JOIN superpower AS T8 ON T7."XCL_013" = T8."XCL_030" WHERE T7."XCL_012" = T1."XCL_018" AND T8."XCL_031" = 'Agility')
ORDER BY T1."XCL_028" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.XCL_019
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.XCL_013 = sp.XCL_030
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
WHERE sp.XCL_031 = 'Agility'
  AND s.XCL_027 != (SELECT XCL_001 FROM alignment WHERE XCL_002 = 'Neutral')
  AND a.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
  AND ha.XCL_011 > (
      SELECT AVG(ha2.XCL_011)
      FROM hero_attribute ha2
      JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.XCL_010 = a2.XCL_003
      WHERE a2.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
  )
ORDER BY s.XCL_020 DESC
LIMIT 1
